purpose: Describe the already-observed scene dependence of the frozen U6b opacity result without rerendering, refitting, retuning, changing a gate, or creating a new efficacy claim.
allowedAnalyses: copy the frozen scene-level primary deltas against baseline and shuffled controls
report per-scene coverage, mean absolute depth error, p95 depth error and within-10cm summary deltas already derivable from the frozen result
report target-level within-5cm win counts and descriptive median target deltas from the frozen target records
rank scenes descriptively by the already-frozen candidate-minus-baseline and candidate-minus-shuffled primary effects
report the descriptive range across the five frozen scene effects
forbiddenAnalyses: read raw source assets to fit a new transfer rule
change opacity exponent, base opacity, floor, clipping, alpha cutoff or covariance
change source or target frame selection
recompute or replace the confirmatory gate
search thresholds or subgroups to recover a positive efficacy claim
drop, replace or reweight any U6b room
treat post-hoc descriptive patterns as confirmatory evidence
claimBoundary: U6c is a read-only post-hoc explanation aid for the sealed negative/null U6b result. It cannot change the U6b decision or justify tuning on the exposed five-room set.
